cause: The ranked PvP cold-start initializer upserted three unchanged character_titles rows. The existing catalog trigger correctly treated each updated row set as a policy change, so duo pairStep continually reset its cursor before completing team evaluation. Live statement statistics showed 37,671 calls/updated rows for this exact title upsert and no updates to the other battle catalogs in the observed statistics window.
change: Guard the three title upserts with actual managed-field comparisons. Unchanged seeds no longer write rows or change rating policy; outdated fields still repair. CMS power/art, ownership, pairing checks, triggers, schedules and reward amounts are unchanged.

verification.reproduction: Both SQLite and PostgreSQL pipeline tests failed before the fix: five repeated initializers advanced policy revision from 4 to 19.
verification.regression: Both engines now preserve title rows and policy revision for unchanged seeds, repair a changed title exactly once, retain CMS power/art/id, finish the same weekly season's pairing, and admit a match.

scoped.reason: Local idempotency fix in three ranked title catalog upserts. No schema, shared transaction/authentication foundation, reward rules, or dependencies changed. Verify the cold-start reset regression, independent weekly duo lifecycle and Worker compilation.

liveRecovery.method: Existing runRankedDuoMaintenance with its scheduler lease, latest-profile validation, normal strong/weak pairing and unchanged admission rules. Existing cron and bounded private operator continuation completed the season. No direct status/seed overrides.
liveRecovery.checks: 134 existing entries retained, 67 teams, 134 distinct team members, no waiting entries or broken member links. The visible ACTIVE season is within its original battle window.

followup.cause: After policy churn stopped, a batch with active inventory writers repeatedly failed DUO_PROFILE_BUILDING. Rebuild discarded every completed profile when any one source version changed.
followup.change: Cache and return only independently validated profiles; the existing bounded loop rechecks source/policy versions and retries only missing accounts. Continuously changing accounts remain blocked; no stale snapshot is accepted.
followup.reproduction: Four SQLite/PostgreSQL regressions failed before the change and pass after it, including refusal to cache unstable profiles.

scoped.reason: Directly observed remaining duo startup blocker: preserve valid per-account cache work during bounded profile rebuild retries. Existing account/policy checks, leases, transaction implementation and schema remain unchanged.
